_recipe.title: Before / after transformation
_recipe.when: Show a result: fitness, skincare, home makeover, cleaning, a website redesign, a client's growth, a bill that dropped. Reels, Shorts, TikTok.
beats: Hook: the before number struck out, the after number lands by ~2s.
What changed: before vs after, two rows each.
How: three numbered steps that got the result.
The headline result as a counting number on a full-colour background.
Proof: the client / customer in their own words.
copyTips: Only real results with the person's permission; give the time frame ("in 8 weeks") so the claim is honest.
Health, fitness, skincare or money results: add "Results vary" to the CTA sub. Never promise a result.
Have before / after photos? Add two "image" scenes after beat 1 (files in public/images/, "fit": "cover", captions "Before" / "After").
The strike value is one number or word ("₹8,000", "92 kg", "2 leads"); the punch is the after value.
Pop + bouncy is upbeat and friendly. Premium services: --theme editorial. Bold creator style: --theme midnight.
